heading: The magi didn't *travel alone.*
lede: There's always room for one more. Christmas is the easiest invitation of the year. Pick a service, tweak the message and send it to a friend, a neighbor or a coworker.
message: Hey! I'm going to Christmas at Christ Community Church on {service}. It's one hour, really relaxed, with carols and candlelight. Want to come with me? {link}
textPageLede: Tap the button and your invite is already written. Just pick a friend and hit send.
textPageMessage: I'm going to Christmas at Christ Community Church and would love for you to come with me. Christmas Eve services are Thursday, Dec 24 at 2, 4 and 6 PM, plus Wednesday, Dec 23 at 6 PM. Here are the details: {link}
